entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments: A Prayer of David. Bow down Your ear, O LORD, hear me; for I [am] poor and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy; O You my God, save Your servant who trusts in You.

entries.title: Psalms 86:3
segments: Be merciful to me, O Lord; for I cry to You daily.

entries.title: Psalms 86:4
segments: Give joy to the soul of Your servant; for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 86:5
segments: For You, Lord, [are] good and ready to forgive, and rich in mercy to all those who call on You.

entries.title: Psalms 86:6
segments: Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my prayers.

entries.title: Psalms 86:7
segments: In the day of my trouble I will call on You; for You will answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 86:8
segments: Among the gods [there is] none like You, O Lord; non [are] like Your works.

entries.title: Psalms 86:9
segments: All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord, and shall glorify Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:10
segments: For You [are] great and do wonderful things; You alone [are] God.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: Teach me Your way, O LORD; I will walk in Your truth; my heart rejoices to fear Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:12
segments: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: For great [is] Your mercy toward me; and You have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

entries.title: Psalms 86:14
segments: O God, the proud have risen against me, and the company of violent [men] have sought after my life, and have not set You before them.

entries.title: Psalms 86:15
segments: But You, O God, [are] God full of pity, and gracious, long-suffering, and rich in mercy and truth.

entries.title: Psalms 86:16
segments: Oh turn to me, and have mercy on me; give Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your handmaid.

entries.title: Psalms 86:17
segments: Show me a token for good, so that they who hate me may see and be ashamed; because You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
